id: \bTerminus Cave is to the south of us. It holds a lot of mystery to it.
en: \bTerminus Cave is to the south of us. It holds a lot of mystery to it.
it: \bLa Grotta Climax si trova a sud di qui. È avvolta da molti misteri.
\rSono sicura che qui non cambierà mai niente.

id: \bSawyer: What are you doing here \PN? Well, I guess that doesn't matter. I've gotten a lot stronger. I have five badges now. Let me show you.
en: \bSawyer: What are you doing here \PN? Well, I guess that doesn't matter. I've gotten a lot stronger. I have five badges now. Let me show you.
it: \bSawyer: Che ci fai qui, \PN? Beh, immagino non abbia importanza. Sono diventato molto più forte. Ora ho cinque Medaglie. Lascia che te lo dimostri.

id: \bWith your help my battle strategies are getting better and better. Next time we meet I won't be so easy.
en: \bWith your help my battle strategies are getting better and better. Next time we meet I won't be so easy.
it: \bGrazie al tuo aiuto le mie strategie di lotta migliorano sempre di più. La prossima volta che ci incontriamo non sarò così facile da battere.

id: \bAlain: I'm trying to figure something out. Don't bother me right now.
en: \bAlain: I'm trying to figure something out. Don't bother me right now.
it: \bAlain: Sto cercando di capire una cosa. Non disturbarmi adesso.

id: \bAlain: I saw the battle you had with that boy over there. I need to experience it for myself.
en: \bAlain: I saw the battle you had with that boy over there. I need to experience it for myself.
it: \bAlain: Ho visto la lotta che hai fatto con quel ragazzo laggiù. Devo provarla di persona.

id: \bYou seem like you have a lot of potential. I'll keep an eye out for you.
en: \bYou seem like you have a lot of potential. I'll keep an eye out for you.
it: \bSembri avere un grande potenziale. Ti terrò d'occhio.

id: \rDon't waste it on a Water type.
en: \rDon't waste it on a Water type.

it: Ponte Mosaico\nUna città che unisce le differenze.

id: \rDon't waste it on a Fire type.
en: \rDon't waste it on a Fire type.

id: \bI have no idea what our town slogan means.
en: \bI have no idea what our town slogan means.
it: \bNon ho idea di cosa significhi il motto della nostra città.

id: \rThis town is so peaceful. I hope it always stays like this.
en: \rThis town is so peaceful. I hope it always stays like this.
it: \rQuesta città è così tranquilla. Spero che resti sempre così.
